promise: Inspect GitHub access drift and apply the roster changes the user has authorized.
audience: Repository owners administering collaborator access from a declared roster.
trigger: Audit, preview or apply GitHub collaborator changes from a roster.

modes.name: Audit
modes.when: The owner needs to inspect access drift.

modes.name: Preview
modes.when: A roster change is being reviewed.
modes.output: A dry-run of invitations, permission changes and removals.

modes.name: Apply
modes.when: The exact access change is authorized.
modes.output: Actual GitHub operations with circuit-breaker and incomplete-roster checks.

examples.title: Fictional roster review
examples.brief: A fictional repository roster contains a mistyped role key.
examples.before: A sync could treat omitted members as removal candidates.
examples.after: Warnings and incomplete-resolution gates make the roster problem reviewable before mutation.
examples.why: The declared roster and the proposed changes must both be inspectable.

boundaries: Native addteam remains the executable and import namespace; no coaching skill or hidden invitation automation is introduced.
Audit/dry-run may read GitHub; tests use mocks and do not invite users, accept invitations, change permissions or send welcome issues.
A removal circuit breaker is an operational limit; it does not itself authorize any access change.

verification.name: Native functional baseline
verification.evidence: 287 native mocked tests and 2 roster parsing checks passed; no GitHub invitation or permission mutation.

verification.name: Source-specific acceptance
verification.expected: Check real configuration/schema/validation branches without remote execution.
verification.evidence: 287 native mocked tests and 2 roster parsing checks passed; no GitHub invitation or permission mutation.

verification.name: Live execution acceptance
verification.expected: Explicitly authorized real provider, invite or video task.
verification.evidence: No paid model call, real invitation, permission mutation, browser recording or film render was performed.

verification.name: Clean wheel installation
verification.command: Build wheel, install into a fresh venv, then run installed entry points outside checkout
verification.expected: Stable native interfaces and packaged assets survive installation.
verification.evidence: All three wheels installed in a fresh Python 3.12 environment. Team Access help and TeaserKit no-AI storyboard validation passed; Imagen installed stdio smoke is recorded separately.

sources.role: Retained native owner implementation, import/CLI interfaces and complete source history.

consolidation: Public family repository name changes independently from stable native package/CLI/import identity.
No forced portable coaching wrapper; ordinary execution stays directly installable.
publication_status: Installation and evidence scopes are documented below.
